m0-exp-layout.change: Thumb exp high-word layout: the 512 aux words of t_eps rows 0..511 (stride-16 interleaved) copied unchanged into contiguous uint32_t t_hb[512]; the 8 stride-16 loads in t_mt, t_mn, t_exp_res, t_exp_den and the two xrow/xkm/xkq table loads in t_eik_exp now index t_hb. t_eps is untouched, so aliases (t_xrow, t_xkm, t_xkq, t_dkn, tanh/sigmoid row pointers, dead NaN-branch t_eps casts) keep their data. Result: thumbv6m +2084 bytes, S worse; rv32im identical code (EIK_SEL selects the _r path).

m0-exp-reduction.change: One exact specialization of negative exp reduction for row 10. Thumbv6-M regressed on both seeds; RV32IM text and scores are identical. Exhaustive host and all-target checks passed.

m0-sigmoid-cell.change: Use directly addressable narrow coefficients for the 91 negative Thumb sigmoid cells. The original shared table and rounding path are preserved. Both Thumb targets regress, and RV32IM emits identical scored text and rodata.

m0-tanh-refine.change: Lower the fast rounding cutoff in the biased-exponent-119 Thumb tanh path using a certified one-sided residual. Both signs and all changed cells are covered. The extra guard cost offsets the refinements saved.

rv-exp-interval.change: Single early unsigned word-range check in eik_exp_r for [0xBF800001,0xC0800000], jumping to the identical original cubic cell and refinement arithmetic. RV32 regresses by about 15.2%; Thumb allocated sections and scores are unchanged under the preserved id50 selector. No takeover recommendation. Full-population stage scores paired with unchanged id50, two-seed quick sanitizer checks, complete all-input host checks and selected object checks retained; bounded evaluate attempts documented separately.

rv-exp-loads.change: Typed table-row indexing in the two RV32IM positive exp reductions. Same-input comparison with former submission 50. RV32IM regressed and both Thumb images were byte-identical.

rv-tanh-quadratic.change: Guarded quadratic (degree-reduced) fast path in eik_tanh_r cells_ for tld_r rows 0..27 (t in [0x7B201000,0x7C..), c1!=0): drops the c3*t cubic term via per-row precomputed c2' = c2 + mulhsx(c3, cell-centre t) (new 28-entry int32 table tq_r, 112 bytes), keeps the high-half multiply formulation, returns w-(Vq>>8) only when Vq mod 256 lies in an exhaustively proven window (even rows [4,213], odd rows [44,253]) so the cubic would return the identical value; otherwise falls through to the unchanged cubic/refinement. Result: rv32im S regresses (see ratios); thumbv6m code generation unchanged.

shared-small-sigmoid.change: Negative trial vs id50 (eligible, distinct normalised source; not a duplicate): one target-independent pre-selector fast path in eik_sigmoid for |x| < 2^-7: returns 0.5 for |x| < 2^-24, else floor(a+1/2) of the affine term a = x*2^22 (x>0, ulp 2^-24) or |x|*2^23 (x<0, ulp 2^-25) in Q15, fast return only when the Q15 fraction exceeds a per-exponent floor of the x^3/48 bound, otherwise the unchanged id50 selector and kernels. Correct on all 2^32 inputs of all three functions (host UBSan/ASan) and on 12 affected sigmoid chunks per target, but S regresses on both boards (rv32im ~1.08x, thumbv6m ~1.12x): the range test runs before id50's first branch on every call (rv32im 4 extra instructions before bltz; thumbv6m ~8 before the original lsls/bmi), and the fast body (~22-26 instr) is slower than id50's own rv32 affine path. See README.md.
